description.short: Chat with your Snowflake Cortex Agent in Teams (unofficial).
description.full:
Open-source Snowflake Labs sample — provided as-is and not an officially supported Snowflake product.

Chat with your Cortex Agents from Microsoft Teams using Entra SSO.

• Personal app — keep threads and pick an agent
• Tabs — add the chat to a channel, group chat, or meeting
• Bot — @mention the app; commands: help, choose agent, starter prompts
• Messages — ask an agent from the compose box without leaving the conversation

Source, privacy, terms, and permissions: https://github.com/Snowflake-Labs/snowflake-agents-embed
